description: Current weather right now at a place: the observed analysis at the exact point (temperature, dew point, relative humidity derived from them, wind speed, direction and gusts, pressure, visibility, cloud cover) plus the nearest station report. Values are in `units` (imperial by default; labels in analysis.units); nearest_station is the report as filed, with its distance in meters, and a forecast is get_forecast. Example: {"location": "Pella, IA"}.

location.description: Space: one place (place text, ZIP or `lat,lon`). EDR position; `nearest` on a feature product (non-empty).

units.description: metric, imperial or si; omitted returns each variable's catalog `units` (SI).

name: get_current_conditions

_sources.description: Per-source provenance: what produced these values and when.

time.description: Valid time of the analysis frame (UTC).

attribution.description: Attribution the dataset licence requires. Cite it when quoting these values.

data_status.description: Present only when the data service did not answer and a cached copy was served.

nearest_station.description: The nearest station report, its id and distance_m.

title: Get current conditions
